passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.1
passages.text: Mittit Hypermestra de tot modo fratribus uni —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.2
passages.text: Cetera nuptarum crimine turba iacet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.3
passages.text: Clausa domo teneor gravibusque coercita vinclis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.4
passages.text: Est mihi supplicii causa fuisse piam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.5
passages.text: Quod manus extimuit iugulo demittere ferrum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.6
passages.text: Sum rea; laudarer, si scelus ausa forem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.7
passages.text: Esse ream praestat, quam sic placuisse parenti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.8
passages.text: Non piget inmunes caedis habere manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.9
passages.text: Me pater igne licet, quem non violavimus, urat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.10
passages.text: Quaeque aderant sacris, tendat in ora faces;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.11
passages.text: Aut illo iugulet, quem non bene tradidit ensem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.12
passages.text: Ut, qua non cecidit vir nece, nupta cadam —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.13
passages.text: Non tamen, ut dicant morientia 'paenitet!' ora,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.14
passages.text: Efficiet. non est, quam piget esse, pia.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.15
passages.text: Paeniteat sceleris Danaum saevasque sorores;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.16
passages.text: Hic solet eventus facta nefanda sequi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.17
passages.text: Cor pavet admonitu temeratae sanguine noctis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.18
passages.text: Et subitus dextrae praepedit ossa tremor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.19
passages.text: Quam tu caede putes fungi potuisse mariti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.20
passages.text: Scribere de facta non sibi caede timet!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.21
passages.text: Sed tamen experiar. modo facta crepuscula terris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.22
passages.text: Ultima pars lucis primaque noctis erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.23
passages.text: Ducimur Inachides magni sub tecta Pelasgi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.24
passages.text: Et socer armatas accipit ipse nurus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.25
passages.text: Undique conlucent praecinctae lampades auro;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.26
passages.text: Dantur in invitos inpia tura focos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.27
passages.text: Vulgus 'Hymen, Hymenaee!' vocant. fugit ille vocantis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.28
passages.text: Ipsa Iovis coniunx cessit ab urbe sua!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.29
passages.text: Ecce, mero dubii, comitum clamore frequentes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.30
passages.text: Flore novo madidas inpediente comas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.31
passages.text: In thalamos laeti — thalamos, sua busta! — feruntur

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.32
passages.text: Strataque corporibus funere digna premunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.33
passages.text: Iamque cibo vinoque graves somnoque iacebant,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.34
passages.text: Securumque quies alta per Argos erat —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.35
passages.text: Circum me gemitus morientum audire videbar;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.36
passages.text: Et tamen audibam, quodque verebar erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.37
passages.text: Sanguis abit, mentemque calor corpusque relinquit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.38
passages.text: Inque novo iacui frigida facta toro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.39
passages.text: Ut leni Zephyro graciles vibrantur aristae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.40
passages.text: Frigida populeas ut quatit aura comas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.41
passages.text: Aut sic, aut etiam tremui magis. ipse iacebas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.42
passages.text: Quemque tibi dederant vina, soporis eras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.43
passages.text: Excussere metum violenti iussa parentis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.44
passages.text: Erigor et capio tela tremente manu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.45
passages.text: Non ego falsa loquar: ter acutum sustulit ensem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.46
passages.text: Ter male sublato reccidit ense manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.47
passages.text: Admovi iugulo — sine me tibi vera fateri! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.48
passages.text: Admovi iugulo tela paterna tuo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.49
passages.text: Sed timor et pietas crudelibus obstitit ausis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.50
passages.text: Castaque mandatum dextra refugit opus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.51
passages.text: Purpureos laniata sinus, laniata capillos

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.52
passages.text: Exiguo dixi talia verba sono:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.53
passages.text: 'Saevus, Hypermestra, pater est tibi; iussa parentis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.54
passages.text: Effice; germanis sit comes iste suis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.55
passages.text: Femina sum et virgo, natura mitis et annis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.56
passages.text: Non faciunt molles ad fera tela manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.57
passages.text: Quin age, dumque iacet, fortis imitare sorores —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.58
passages.text: Credibile est caesos omnibus esse viros!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.59
passages.text: Si manus haec aliquam posset committere caedem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.60
passages.text: Morte foret dominae sanguinolenta suae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.61
passages.text: Hanc meruere necem patruelia regna tenendo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.62
passages.text: Cum sene nos inopi turba vagamur inops.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.63
passages.text: Finge viros meruisse mori — quid fecimus ipsae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.64
passages.text: Quo mihi commisso non licet esse piae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.65
passages.text: Quid mihi cum ferro? quo bellica tela puellae?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.66
passages.text: Aptior est digitis lana colusque meis.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.67
passages.text: Haec ego; dumque queror, lacrimae sua verba sequuntur

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.68
passages.text: Deque meis oculis in tua membra cadunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.69
passages.text: Dum petis amplexus sopitaque bracchia iactas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.70
passages.text: Paene manus telo saucia facta tua est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.71
passages.text: Iamque patrem famulosque patris lucemque timebam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.72
passages.text: Expulerunt somnos haec mea dicta tuos:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.73
passages.text: 'Surge age, Belide, de tot modo fratribus unus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.74
passages.text: Nox tibi, ni properas, ista perennis erit!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.75
passages.text: Territus exsurgis; fugit omnis inertia somni;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.76
passages.text: Adspicis in timida fortia tela manu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.77
passages.text: Quaerenti causam 'dum nox sinit, effuge!' dixi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.78
passages.text: Dum nox atra sinit, tu fugis, ipsa moror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.79
passages.text: Mane erat, et Danaus generos ex caede iacentis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.80
passages.text: Dinumerat. summae criminis unus abes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.81
passages.text: Fert male cognatae iacturam mortis in uno

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.82
passages.text: Et queritur facti sanguinis esse parum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.83
passages.text: Abstrahor a patriis pedibus, raptamque capillis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.84
passages.text: Haec meruit pietas praemia! — carcer habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.85
passages.text: Scilicet ex illo Iunonia permanet ira,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.86
passages.text: Cum bos ex homine est, ex bove facta dea.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.87
passages.text: At satis est poenae teneram mugisse puellam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.88
passages.text: Nec, modo formosam, posse placere Iovi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.89
passages.text: Adstitit in ripa liquidi nova vacca parentis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.90
passages.text: Cornuaque in patriis non sua vidit aquis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.91
passages.text: Conatoque queri mugitus edidit ore

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.92
passages.text: Territaque est forma, territa voce sua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.93
passages.text: Quid furis, infelix? quid te miraris in umbra?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.94
passages.text: Quid numeras factos ad nova membra pedes?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.95
passages.text: Illa Iovis magni paelex metuenda sorori

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.96
passages.text: Fronde levas nimiam caespitibusque famem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.97
passages.text: Fonte bibis spectasque tuam stupefacta figuram

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.98
passages.text: Et, te ne feriant, quae geris, arma, times,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.99
passages.text: Quaeque modo, ut posses etiam Iove digna videri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.100
passages.text: Dives eras, nuda nuda recumbis humo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.101
passages.text: Per mare, per terras cognataque flumina curris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.102
passages.text: Dat mare, dant amnes, dat tibi terra viam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.103
passages.text: Quae tibi causa fugae? quid tu freta longa pererras?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.104
passages.text: Non poteris vultus effugere ipsa tuos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.105
passages.text: Inachi, quo properas? eadem sequerisque fugisque;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.106
passages.text: Tu tibi dux comiti, tu comes ipsa duci.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.107
passages.text: Per septem Nilus portus emissus in aequor

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.108
passages.text: Exuit insana paelicis ora bove.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.109
passages.text: Ultima quid refero, quorum mihi cana senectus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.110
passages.text: Auctor? dant anni, quod querar, ecce, mei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.111
passages.text: Bella pater patruusque gerunt; regnoque domoque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.112
passages.text: Pellimur; eiectos ultimus orbis habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.115
passages.text: De fratrum populo pars exiguissima restat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.116
passages.text: Quique dati leto, quaeque dedere, fleo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.117
passages.text: Nam mihi quot fratres, totidem periere sorores.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.118
passages.text: Accipiat lacrimas utraque turba meas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.119
passages.text: En, ego, quod vivis, poenae crucianda reservor;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.120
passages.text: Quid fiet sonti, cum rea laudis agar

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.121
passages.text: Et consanguineae quondam centensima turbae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.122
passages.text: Infelix uno fratre manente cadam?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.123
passages.text: At tu, siqua piae, Lynceu, tibi cura sororis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.124
passages.text: Quaeque tibi tribui munera, dignus habes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.125
passages.text: Vel fer opem, vel dede neci defunctaque vita

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.126
passages.text: Corpora furtivis insuper adde rogis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.127
passages.text: Et sepeli lacrimis perfusa fidelibus ossa,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.128
passages.text: Sculptaque sint titulo nostra sepulcra brevi:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.129
passages.text: 'Exul Hypermestra, pretium pietatis iniquum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.130
passages.text: Quam mortem fratri depulit, ipsa tulit.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.131
passages.text: Scribere plura libet, sed pondere lapsa catenae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 14.132
passages.text: Est manus, et vires subtrahit ipse timor.
